key.name: sync-account
key.description: Id of the online account the notes are synced with, from Online Accounts; empty keeps the notes on this computer only.

key.name: sync-on-edit
key.description: Sync a few seconds after a note changes, instead of waiting for the next automatic sync.

key.name: lock-after
key.description: Minutes without using a password protected section before it locks again; 0 keeps it open until Notes closes.

key.name: recognize-images
key.description: Read the text of pictures and printouts with the text recognition service so searches find it.

key.name: last-view
key.description: The list shown when the window opens: all, pinned or folder:NAME.

key.name: last-note
key.description: Id of the note opened last.
